issuing_authority.value: Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services (department), with the recommendation of the Board of Medicine and Surgery
issuing_authority.quote: Department means the Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services
umbrella_agency.quote: Department means the Division of Public Health of the Department of Health and Human Services.

age_minimum.quote: No individual shall be issued a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act until he or she has furnished satisfactory evidence to the department that he or she is of good character and has attained the age of nineteen years

moral_character_required.quote: No individual shall be issued a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act until he or she has furnished satisfactory evidence to the department that he or she is of good character

degree_required.value: graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine
degree_required.quote: Present proof that he or she is a graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine

accrediting_body.quote: An accredited school or college of medicine means one approved by the board, and such school or college shall meet and maintain generally minimum standards approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: Present proof that he or she is a graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine

school_approval_basis.quote: An accredited school or college of medicine means one approved by the board, and such school or college shall meet and maintain generally minimum standards approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: Present proof that he or she is a graduate of an accredited school or college of medicine

required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

experience_source.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

duration.value: at least one year (domestic); at least two years (foreign medical graduates)
duration.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board or, if a foreign medical graduate, present proof that he or she has served at least two years of graduate medical education approved by the board

kind.quote: Graduate medical education or residency means a program of supervised educational training, approved by the board, in a medical specialty at an accredited hospital, an accredited school or college of medicine, or an accredited school or college of osteopathic medicine, that follows the completion of undergraduate medical education.

exams.name: Licensing examination (USMLE or equivalent) approved by the board
exams.notes: All parts must be passed within 10 years; failing any part within 4 attempts requires one additional year of postgraduate training. The IMLC uses USMLE or COMLEX.
exams.quote: Pass a licensing examination approved by the board covering appropriate medical subjects.

interval_years.quote: The credential to practice a profession shall be renewed biennially upon request of the credentialed person and upon documentation of continuing competency

required.quote: The appropriate board shall establish continuing competency requirements for persons seeking renewal of a credential.

hours_per_period.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

period_years.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

value: At least 3 hours biennially regarding prescribing opiates (for physicians who prescribe controlled substances), including 0.5 hours on the prescription drug monitoring program
topical_requirements.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates as defined in section 28-401. One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program described in sections 71-2454 to 71-2456.

available.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact or meet the standards set by the board pursuant to section 38-126

requirements.value: Applicant must comply with the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact requirements or meet board-set standards. May also be eligible under general reciprocity provisions in section 38-129.02 for other credential holders.
requirements.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact or meet the standards set by the board pursuant to section 38-126

regulatory_model.quote: No individual shall engage in the following practices unless such individual has obtained a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act: ... (y) Medicine and surgery;

credential_type.quote: License means an authorization issued by the department to an individual to engage in a profession or to a business to provide services which would otherwise be unlawful in this state in the absence of such authorization.

is_mandatory.quote: No individual shall engage in the following practices unless such individual has obtained a credential under the Uniform Credentialing Act: ... (y) Medicine and surgery;

title_protection.quote: Persons who attach to their name the title of M.D., surgeon, physician, physician and surgeon, or any word or abbreviation and who indicate that they are engaged in the treatment or diagnosis of ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, infirmity, or any physical or mental condition of human beings

scope_protection.quote: Every act or practice falling within the practice of medicine and surgery as defined in section 38-2024 and not specially excepted in this section shall constitute the practice of medicine and surgery and may be performed in this state only by those licensed by law to practice medicine in Nebraska.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation of material facts in procuring or attempting to procure a credential
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation of material facts in procuring or attempting to procure a credential

disciplinary_grounds.description: Immoral or dishonorable conduct evidencing unfitness to practice the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Immoral or dishonorable conduct evidencing unfitness to practice the profession in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with a treatment program or aftercare program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program, including, but not limited to, a program entered into under the Licensee Assistance Program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a misdemeanor or felony with rational connection to fitness to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of (a) a misdemeanor or felony under Nebraska law or federal law, or (b) a crime in any jurisdiction which, if committed within this state, would have constituted a misdemeanor or felony under Nebraska law and which has a rational connection with the fitness or capacity of the applicant or credential holder to practice the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice of the profession fraudulently, beyond authorized scope, with gross incompetence or negligence, or in a pattern of incompetent or negligent conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice of the profession (a) fraudulently, (b) beyond its authorized scope, (c) with gross incompetence or gross negligence, or (d) in a pattern of incompetent or negligent conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice while ability is impaired by alcohol, controlled substances, drugs, or disability
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice of the profession while the ability to practice is impaired by alcohol, controlled substances, drugs, mind-altering substances, physical disability, mental disability, or emotional disability

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental incapacity to practice the profession as evidenced by legal judgment or lawful determination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental incapacity to practice the profession as evidenced by a legal judgment or a determination by other lawful means

disciplinary_grounds.description: Illness, deterioration, or disability that impairs the ability to practice the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Illness, deterioration, or disability that impairs the ability to practice the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting, aiding, or abetting the practice of a profession by an uncredentialed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting, aiding, or abetting the practice of a profession or the performance of activities requiring a credential by a person not credentialed to do so

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a credential denied, refused renewal, limited, suspended, revoked, or disciplined by another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having had his or her credential denied, refused renewal, limited, suspended, revoked, or disciplined in any manner similar to section 38-196 by another state or jurisdiction based upon acts by the applicant or credential holder similar to acts described in this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of untruthful, deceptive, or misleading statements in advertisements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of untruthful, deceptive, or misleading statements in advertisements, including failure to comply with section 38-124

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distribution of intoxicating liquors, controlled substances, or drugs for unlawful purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Distribution of intoxicating liquors, controlled substances, or drugs for any other than lawful purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of the Uniform Credentialing Act or applicable rules and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of the Uniform Credentialing Act or the rules and regulations relating to the particular profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful invasion of the field of practice of any profession the credential holder is not credentialed to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unlawful invasion of the field of practice of any profession regulated by the Uniform Credentialing Act which the credential holder is not credentialed to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act or related regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the Uniform Controlled Substances Act or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant to the act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to file a report required by certain statutory provisions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to file a report required by section 38-1,124, 38-1,125, or 71-552

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain the requirements necessary to obtain a credential
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain the requirements necessary to obtain a credential

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order issued by the department
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of an order issued by the department

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in section 38-179
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in section 38-179

definition_quote.value: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches; Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery; Persons holding themselves out to the public as being qualified in the diagnosis or treatment of diseases, ailments, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or injuries of human beings; Persons who suggest, recommend, or prescribe any form of treatment for the intended palliation, relief, or cure of any physical or mental ailment of any person
definition_quote.quote: Persons who publicly profess to be physicians or surgeons or publicly profess to assume the duties incident to the practice of medicine, surgery, or any of their branches

value: recommending or prescribing any form of treatment
examination and treatment of persons afflicted with ailments, diseases, injuries, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition
methods_authorized.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery

drug_authority.value: Licensed physicians may prescribe and furnish medicines; osteopathic physicians who have demonstrated adequate training may prescribe and administer drugs and medicines. Prescribing controlled substances to oneself or immediate family members (except in emergencies) constitutes unprofessional conduct.
drug_authority.quote: Persons who prescribe and furnish medicine for some illness, disease, ailment, injury, pain, deformity, or any physical or mental condition, or treat the same by surgery

license_status_types.quote: Temporary educational permit means a permit to practice medicine and surgery, osteopathic medicine and surgery, or any of their allied specialties in graduate medical education, a fellowship, or a refresher course.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must provide a permanent ECFMG certificate currently in effect, or credentials showing passage of the Visa Qualifying Examination, or (for Fifth Pathway graduates) evidence of passing the ECFMG examination. Foreign medical graduates must also complete at least two years of approved graduate medical education (vs. one year for domestic graduates).
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if a foreign medical graduate, provide a copy of a permanent certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates that is currently effective and relates to such applicant or provide such credentials as are necessary to certify that such foreign medical graduate has successfully passed the Visa Qualifying Examination or its successor or equivalent examination

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Present proof that he or she has served at least one year of graduate medical education approved by the board

pain_management_education_required.quote: the continuing competency requirements for a nurse midwife, dentist, physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, podiatrist, and veterinarian who prescribes controlled substances shall include at least three hours of continuing education biennially regarding prescribing opiates

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: One-half hour of the three hours of continuing education shall cover the prescription drug monitoring program described in sections 71-2454 to 71-2456.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Telehealth is defined broadly to include services originating from a patient's home or any other location; the statute does not impose specific additional prescribing restrictions for telehealth beyond standard practice requirements.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: Telehealth means the use of medical information electronically exchanged from one site to another, whether synchronously or asynchronously, to aid a credential holder in the diagnosis or treatment of a patient.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Persons who are physically located in another state but who, through the use of any medium, including an electronic medium, perform for compensation any service which constitutes the healing arts that would affect the diagnosis or treatment of an individual located in this state.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: An applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery based on a license in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia shall comply with the requirements of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact beginning on the effective date of the compact

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: Physician assistant means any person who graduates from an approved program, who has passed a proficiency examination, and who the department, with the recommendation of the board, approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician; specific prescriptive authority scope governed by rules and collaborative agreement terms.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Physician assistant means any person who graduates from an approved program, who has passed a proficiency examination, and who the department, with the recommendation of the board, approves to perform medical services under a collaborative agreement with the supervision of a physician

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The department may contract to provide a Licensee Assistance Program to credential holders regulated by the department. The program shall be limited to providing education, referral assistance, and monitoring of compliance with treatment for abuse of, dependence on, or active addiction to alcohol, any controlled substance, or any mind-altering substance

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: Require the applicant to submit to a complete diagnostic examination at the expense of the applicant by one or more physicians or other qualified professionals appointed by the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: A physician locum tenens may be issued by the department, with the recommendation of the board, to an individual who holds an active license to practice medicine and surgery or osteopathic medicine and surgery in another state when circumstances indicate a need for the issuance of a physician locum tenens in the State of Nebraska.
